purpose: Part 1/2 of verified hard-tail 10-record item effect batch 022; together these files contain exactly 10 reviewed records with complete captured mechanics.

items/drow-scorpion-chain-590.name: Drow Scorpion Chain
items/drow-scorpion-chain-590.effectSummary: The exotic chain has 10-foot reach but can also attack adjacent foes. It can make trip attacks, and the wielder can drop it to avoid being tripped on a failed trip attempt; it grants +2 on opposed attack rolls to disarm or resist disarm. A properly sized chain can use Weapon Finesse despite not being light, and Exotic Weapon Proficiency, Weapon Focus, or Weapon Specialization chosen for either spiked chain or drow scorpion chain applies to attacks with either weapon.

items/folding-trap.name: Folding Trap
items/folding-trap.effectSummary: Speaking the Draconic command to expand the palm-sized ball is a standard action that unfolds and attaches it as a mechanical trap to available support; speaking the shrink command as a standard action from within 30 feet folds it back into a ball. Known versions are scything blade (CR 1), wall blade (CR 1), tripping chain (CR 2), ceiling pendulum (CR 3), and wall scythe (CR 4). Once deployed it is indistinguishable from the normal trap except for its magic aura; other variants must be automatic-reset mechanical traps that do not substantially alter the environment or incorporate poison, magic, or living organisms.

items/githyankisilversword-683.name: Githyanki Silver Sword
items/githyankisilversword-683.effectSummary: A typical githyanki silver sword is a +1 silvered greatsword. A creature it hits must succeed on Fortitude DC 17 or lose its psionic abilities for 1d4 rounds. The wielder can also use a sunder attack against an adjacent astral traveler’s silver cord; the cord uses its owner’s AC, hardness 10, and 20 hit points. Damage to the cord forces its owner to make Fortitude DC 13 or return to the physical body, and severing the cord kills the traveler instantly. The ability can be placed only on an alchemical-silver melee weapon.

items/mirror-of-life-trapping.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
items/mirror-of-life-trapping.effectSummary: The command-word mirror has 13–18 extradimensional cells. A creature within 30 feet that sees its reflection must make Will DC 19 or be trapped bodily in one cell; an aware creature deliberately avoiding the mirror has only a 50% chance to see its reflection. Constructs, undead, inanimate objects, and other nonliving matter are not trapped, and a victim’s equipment remains outside. The owner can use prisoner-specific command words to show and converse with a captive or release it. If capacity is exceeded, a random captive is freed; breaking the mirror releases all captives.

items/necklace-of-dragons-teeth.name: Necklace Of Dragon's Teeth
items/necklace-of-dragons-teeth.effectSummary: A full necklace begins with twelve consumable fangs. As a standard action, the user removes a fang and throws it onto the ground; on the following round it becomes a draconic myrmidon that acts on the user’s turn for 10 rounds or until slain. The myrmidon loyally defends the user or attacks a chosen target and understands the user’s spoken commands regardless of language. Necklaces found with fewer fangs have proportionally reduced value.
